acme_integrations: Hi, after the 09:12 UTC rollout our tool calls to /invoke-tool are failing. The target service expects positional args but we're seeing params reordered — breaks signature. Can we get urgent help, customer facing outage.

julie_support: Sorry about that — tagging eng oncall. @ops_oncall can you take a look? Can you paste a sample request/response and any request_id?

acme_integrations: sample request/response below (redacted ids):
```json
// request body we send
{
  \"tool\": \"generate_report\",
  \"args\": [\"2026-03-15\", 123, {\"verbose\": true}]
}

// what the customer saw in logs from our router -> runtime (notice args became an object)
{
  \"tool\": \"generate_report\",
  \"args\": {\"0\": \"2026-03-15\", \"1\": 123, \"2\": {\"verbose\": true}}
}
```

deploy-bot: request-mapper v3.2.1 deployed to canary group @ 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z (build 3.2.1-rc4)

max_eng_sre: looking. Quick hypothesis: something in the request-mapper changed how it normalizes arg arrays -> object with numeric keys for sparse arrays. Many downstream tool handlers expect a JSON array (positional). If true, this explains the swap. Do you have a request_id I can trace?

acme_integrations: request_id: r-ff4321f0. We saw the transformed payload in our logs and the downstream service threw "TypeError: expected list, got object". We don't use sparse indices — we always send contiguous arrays.

lee_runtime: that canary includes a change to dedupe query params and 'normalize' arrays by converting to keyed objects for internal routing efficiency. It unintentionally converted all arrays to numeric-keyed objects when certain flags are set (legacy clients + mapper flag). Reverting canary to previous mapper now. Workaround: set header `X-Force-Array-Encoding: true` until patch.

julie_support: please confirm ETA on rollback and let the customer know how to test. I'll open an escalation ticket and notify account team.

lee_runtime: rollback initiated 09:14 UTC, should finish in ~3m for the canary cohort. I'll push a hotfix to preserve array encoding and add a unit test for positional args. Ticket: INF-5789.

acme_integrations: confirmed — after ~09:17 UTC our downstream stopped erroring and signatures look correct again. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

max_eng_sre: follow-up: we'll add a compatibility test in the request-mapper CI that asserts arrays remain arrays in the serialized payload for tool invocations. Assigning to runtime team, PR planned today.

julie_support: closing loop with customer, adding notes to the support ticket and linking INF-5789. :white_check_mark:
